description: Demolition of the existing buildings at Lewisham Retail Park and 66-76 Loampit Vale and construction of buildings 7-24 storeys high comprising 4,343 square metres of commercial floorspace in legacy use classes A1, A2, A3, B1, D1 and D2, 536 residential units, an on-site energy centre, car and cycle parking and associated landscaping.
